note: The only agent packages Studio installs for the user. Each is pinned to one exact version. The lockfile (agent_locks/<id>.package-lock.json, made with npm install --package-lock-only) pins every dependency with its integrity hash, so the install runs `npm ci`. Change a version only after reviewing it, and regenerate its lockfile in the same commit. packageBytes is the approximate size on disk after install; the install needs 2x that free, or minFreeBytes when that is larger (the Claude SDK ships a 349 MB binary).
betaNote: Beta agents (server/agents/beta_catalog.ts): not tested by us. Pinned to the exact version the ACP registry listed on 2026-11-11, with no lockfile (not reviewed): npm checks each package's own checksum and resolves its dependencies within their ranges. Sizes are not known yet.
